sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Earth Release, Wind Release, Barrier, Stable, Efficient

system.description:
You draw dust particles around yourself to create an invisible armor to protect yourself from harm. For the duration, you gain the listed effects. This jutsu ends early if you don Heavy armor or you end it as a bonus action on your turn;

A +2 bonus to your AC

A +2 Bonus to your DR.

At the beginning of each of your turns, you generate a Barrier with 8 Hit Points. If you would gain the benefit of a different Barrier, you must select which Barrier you use for the damage calculation.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this Jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the Barriers hit points by +2. If this Jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the AC and DR Bonus by +1. If this Jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, This jutsu’s duration becomes 1 Hour. If this Jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the AC and DR bonus by +1.
